clue.text: Item on plate I note for diet?

parts.note: a car's number plate carries its reg, short for registration
me (or mi) is the third note of the sol-fa scale

explanation.surface: A dinner guest wonders whether a single thing on the plate counts as a diet.
explanation.definitionFit: A regime is a prescribed course of eating, so a diet is one kind; the question mark flags the loose fit.

clue.text: Immediately apply in writing for audition

indicators.note: audition means hearing, so the phrase is taken as heard rather than spelt

parts.note: to write away for something is to apply for it by letter

explanation.surface: An actor is told to apply in writing for an audition straight away.
explanation.definitionFit: Right away is an idiom for at once, without any delay.

clue.text: UK peninsula where travel used to be endless

parts.note: to go is to travel

indicators.note: endless says the final letter of were is cut off

parts.note: were is a past form of be

explanation.surface: A Welsh peninsula where journeys once seemed never-ending.
explanation.walkthrough: The Gower is a peninsula in South Wales, west of Swansea.
explanation.definitionFit: The Gower is a peninsula of South Wales jutting into the Bristol Channel.

clue.text: Keep leading Tina astray

parts.note: main means chief or leading

indicators.note: astray means gone wrong, so the name's letters wander into a new order

explanation.surface: An instruction to keep someone called Tina from straying.
explanation.definitionFit: To maintain something is to keep it going or keep it in good order.

clue.text: Standard way to address queen touring hospital: "One's cured!"

parts.note: par is the standard or normal level

indicators.note: touring means going round, so the form of address wraps around the hospital letter

parts.note: ma'am is how one addresses the Queen
H is the abbreviation for hospital on maps and signs

explanation.surface: Someone excitedly tells the Queen, being shown round a hospital, that a patient has been healed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'One's cured!' reads as a patient recovering, but cured here means salted and dried, as Italian ham from Parma is.
explanation.definitionFit: Parma ham is a salted, air-dried Italian ham, so it is something that has been cured.

clue.text: Fleshy fruit — a large part oil, unexpectedly

indicators.note: unexpectedly suggests things turning out other than planned, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A fleshy fruit turns out to be largely oil.
explanation.definitionFit: Alligator pear is an old name for the avocado, a fleshy, oil-rich fruit.

clue.text: Assailant who's closer after one's escaped

indicators.note: escaped means got away, so the letter for one leaves the word

parts.note: close weather is humid, so closer means muggier
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: An attacker who moves in closer after one victim gets away.
explanation.walkthrough: 'closer' looks like nearer; it is close in the sense of humid weather.
explanation.definitionFit: A mugger is someone who attacks and robs people in the street, an assailant.

clue.text: Place for flask, maybe, and with it pot

parts.note: hip means fashionable, with it
to pot a ball in snooker is to pocket it

explanation.surface: A trendy spot to keep a hip flask along with some cannabis.
explanation.definitionFit: A hip pocket is the back trouser pocket, where a hip flask is often carried.

clue.text: Capital made out of son being unethically dressed?

indicators.note: being here means being placed in, so the son letter sits inside the fur

parts.note: wearing mink fur is seen by many as unethical dress

explanation.surface: A city whose fortune was made from a son who dressed without scruples.
explanation.definitionFit: Minsk is the capital city of Belarus.

clue.text: Ultimately how irrational that team should keep staring

indicators.note: keeping something means holding it within, so the team surrounds the other pieces

parts.note: a gang is a team or crew

indicators.note: ultimately points to the final letter of the word how

parts.note: pi is the best-known irrational number

explanation.surface: Someone finds it unreasonable that a sports team should go on staring.
explanation.definitionFit: To gawp is to stare open-mouthed, so gawping is staring stupidly.

clue.text: Fetching number available at a bargain

parts.note: an item fetching a price is going for it
a number is a song

explanation.surface: An attractive tune that can be had cheap.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fetching' looks like attractive; it means selling for, as at auction.
explanation.definitionFit: Going for a song is an idiom for being sold very cheaply.

clue.text: Penny's back on stage, wearing a type of bowler

indicators.note: in a down-style charade, on says one piece follows the other

parts.note: a leg is a stage of a journey or race

indicators.note: back says the letters for Penny's are read in the reverse direction

parts.note: Penny's is P plus 's, giving PS
wearing a coat means in a coat

explanation.surface: A man named Penny is back on the stage, wearing a bowler hat.
explanation.walkthrough: The bowler is a cricketer, not a hat. Leg spin is a style of slow bowling in cricket where the ball turns from the leg side.
explanation.definitionFit: Leg spin names a style of cricket delivery, so it labels a kind of slow bowler, the leg-spinner.

clue.text: Reserve bunk, producing card

parts.note: TA is the Territorial Army, Britain's volunteer army reserve
bunk and rot both mean nonsense

explanation.surface: Booking a bunk bed somehow yields a card.
explanation.definitionFit: A tarot is one of a pack of cards used in fortune-telling.

clue.text: Evidently valley life all bad — but this corner's cosy

parts.note: to live in a valley is to live in a glen, a Scottish valley
if all is bad then nothing is fine: O for nothing, then OK

explanation.surface: A grumble that life in the valley is dreadful, yet one corner of the house stays snug.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Evidently' joins the pieces: life IN GLEN with O (zero) OK is obviously all bad.
explanation.definitionFit: An inglenook is a recess beside a large open fireplace, a warm and snug spot by the hearth.

clue.text: American I housed in my own refurbished holiday home

indicators.note: housed in says the single letter is placed within the rearranged letters
refurbished means done up anew, so the letters of my own are rearranged

parts.note: a gite is a French holiday cottage

explanation.surface: An American talks about having done up their own holiday home in France.
explanation.walkthrough: A gite is a French rural holiday cottage, popular with British holidaymakers.
explanation.definitionFit: A Wyomingite is a native of the US state of Wyoming, hence an American.

clue.text: Somehow co-opts US company in the end to make film

indicators.note: somehow says the letters are put together in some unstated new way
in the end points to the last letter of company

explanation.surface: An American company somehow co-opts others to make a film.
explanation.definitionFit: Octopussy is a 1983 James Bond film starring Roger Moore.

clue.text: Take cream off small boy or girl

parts.note: S is the clothing-size abbreviation for small
Kim is a name given to both boys and girls

explanation.surface: A small child takes the cream off the milk.
explanation.definitionFit: To skim milk is to remove the cream floating on top.

clue.text: Blight that hurt top of flower in desert pea

parts.note: to blight is to mar or spoil

indicators.note: in says those pieces go inside the deserting word

parts.note: to rat on someone is to desert them
ow is what you say when something hurts

indicators.note: top of takes the first letter of flower

explanation.surface: A blight harms the flower on a desert pea plant.
explanation.walkthrough: 'desert' looks like arid land; it is the verb to abandon, here RAT.
explanation.definitionFit: Marrowfat is a large variety of pea, often used for mushy peas.

clue.text: US military base opposed strikes being talked of

indicators.note: being talked of says the words are spoken, so they count by their sound

parts.note: fought means opposed, knocks means strikes

explanation.surface: A US base opposed the strikes that people are talking about.
explanation.definitionFit: Fort Knox is a US Army post in Kentucky, famous for its gold vault.

clue.text: Legendary Highlander: one's got so far ahead

indicators.note: ahead says the piece for so far goes before the one

parts.note: yet means so far, as in not yet
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A mythical Scot has managed to get ahead of everyone so far.
explanation.walkthrough: Highlander suggests Scotland, but this one lives in the Himalayas.
explanation.definitionFit: The yeti, or abominable snowman, is a creature of legend said to live high in the Himalayas.

clue.text: Hide after leading lady around old, imposing crash site

indicators.note: around says the hide word wraps the letter for old

parts.note: fur is an animal's hide
post means after, as in post-war
ER, Elizabeth Regina, the Queen, is the nation's leading lady

explanation.surface: An actress's leading lady rounds on a crash site in a strange tale about hiding.
explanation.walkthrough: Crash is slang for sleep, so a crash site is a bed.
explanation.definitionFit: A four-poster is a large, grand bed, and to crash is slang for going to sleep.

clue.text: Cocktail 3 down — forgetting name twice

indicators.note: forgetting means leaving out, so those letters are dropped

parts.note: the answer at 3 down, a word meaning keep

indicators.note: twice says the name letter is taken two times

explanation.surface: A cocktail drinker forgets someone's name twice.
explanation.definitionFit: A mai tai is a rum-based cocktail with lime and orange flavours.

clue.text: Initially, all when in mountain have activity in mind

parts.note: an alp is a mountain

indicators.note: in says those first letters go inside the word have
initially takes the first letters of all and when

explanation.surface: A mountain climber wonders whether the mind stays active at altitude.
explanation.definitionFit: An alpha wave is a rhythm of electrical activity in the brain, seen when the mind is relaxed.

clue.text: City where de Gaulle would appear after church

indicators.note: the city's name would come after the church letters to make the general's first name, so those letters are taken away

parts.note: Charles de Gaulle, French president

explanation.surface: A French city where de Gaulle might turn up after Mass.
explanation.walkthrough: Put CH before the city and you get Charles, de Gaulle's first name.
explanation.definitionFit: Arles is a city in Provence, southern France, known for its Roman remains and Van Gogh.

clue.text: Measure essential to stop me talking back

indicators.note: back says the hidden letters are read backwards
essential to means forming the inner substance of, so the letters lie inside these words

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Something vital to stopping me from answering back.
explanation.walkthrough: The draft took 'Measure essential' as the definition, but 'essential to' is what signals the hidden letters; 'Measure' alone defines TEMPO.
explanation.definitionFit: Tempo is a measure of musical speed, the rate or pace of a piece.

clue.text: How Jersey goes about finding sculptor

parts.note: a Jersey is a breed of cow, and a cow goes moo
re means about or concerning

explanation.surface: How people on the island of Jersey go about finding a sculptor.
explanation.walkthrough: Jersey looks like the island; it is a breed of dairy cow.
explanation.definitionFit: Henry Moore was an English sculptor famous for large abstract bronze figures.

clue.text: The state of the loo's atrocious

indicators.note: atrocious means dreadful, a sign that the letters are badly messed up

explanation.surface: Someone complains about the dreadful state of the toilet.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The state' looks like condition; it is a country.
explanation.definitionFit: Lesotho is an independent kingdom wholly surrounded by South Africa, so a sovereign state.

clue.text: What new divorcee could take to be cause of hang-up?

definitions.text: What new divorcee could take to be cause of hang-up?

parts.words: What new divorcee could take to be cause of hang-up?
parts.note: a newly divorced person might remove a wedding band, while the same phrase means ending a phone call

explanation.surface: A newly divorced person wonders what could be the root of their emotional hang-up.
explanation.walkthrough: Hang-up looks like an emotional problem; it is putting down the telephone.
explanation.definitionFit: To ring off is to end a telephone call, and a divorcee might literally take a wedding band off.

clue.text: Makes leap year visits to see secretive groups

indicators.note: visiting means going in, so the year letter enters the leaping word

parts.note: springs means makes a leap

explanation.surface: Someone makes leap-year visits to observe secret societies.
explanation.definitionFit: Spy rings are networks of secret agents working together, hence secretive groups.

clue.text: Field that's no longer used for camping?

parts.note: ex means former, no longer the case
a tent is what campers use

explanation.surface: A field that has stopped being a campsite.
explanation.walkthrough: The picture suggests a field once used for camping; the definition is field in the sense of scope.
explanation.definitionFit: Field and extent both mean the range or scope that something covers.
